  1. Worth the detour · Cebu

    Basilica Minore del Santo Nino & Magellan's Cross

    The country's oldest Catholic relic and church, beside the 1521 cross planted at Magellan's arrival — the cradle of Philippine Christianity.

    Look for Historic church

    Osmena Boulevard / P. Burgos Street, Cebu City, Philippines

    Recommended by Guide to the Philippines, Wikipedia

  2. Worth the detour · Filipino · Cebu

    Rico's Lechon

    Cebu's most internationally recognised lechon brand and pioneer of the spicy style, open since 1997.

    F. Cabahug Street, Mabolo (and branches), Cebu City, Philippines

    Recommended by Authentic Food Quest, Our Awesome Planet (Anton Diaz)

How this guide was made
